programs.subtitle: Unwind tension and rebuild gentle support for lasting ease.

weeks.themeSubtitle: The original week: permission for your body to finally let go.

days.title: The Gentle Release
days.intention: Today I ease pelvic pain by letting my body stop clenching without realising it.

days.title: Unlock Your Hips
days.intention: Today I ease pelvic pain by getting my hips moving freely again.

days.title: Free Your Spine

days.title: The Supportive Core
days.intention: Today I ease pelvic pain by waking the corset muscle that steadies my body.

days.title: Build Your Anchor

weeks.themeSubtitle: Teach your body to stop clenching, with breath and stillness.

days.title: Unclench Hour
days.intention: Today you practice the skill at the heart of relief: releasing on purpose. This week is about foundations: notice more, force nothing. Let this be your time: no rush, no judgment, just practice.

days.title: Motion is Lotion
days.intention: Soft, rhythmic movement today soothes stiff joints and calms a body stuck on high alert. We are laying groundwork this week, so keep everything slow and curious. Move at your own pace and let your breath lead the way.

days.title: The Calming Breath
days.intention: Today we pair your breath with a gentle squeeze, so your floor learns that resting is normal. Early weeks are for learning your body's signals, not chasing burn. Small, honest efforts today are what your body remembers tomorrow.

days.title: The Long Melt
days.intention: Each stretch today is an invitation, not a demand. Ease in and let gravity do the work. This week is about foundations: notice more, force nothing. Show up gently. Showing up, not pushing hard, is the win.

days.title: Support, Not Strain
days.intention: Today's gentle loading builds the security that lets pain quiet down. We are laying groundwork this week, so keep everything slow and curious. Notice how you feel before and after; that awareness is progress too.

days.title: Yoga for Ease
days.intention: Gentle yoga today lengthens the whole chain from ribs to knees, easing the pull on your pelvis. Early weeks are for learning your body's signals, not chasing burn. You are exactly where you need to be in this process.

days.title: Recovery Ritual
days.intention: Recovery is where your body absorbs the week's work, so give it room today. Early weeks are for learning your body's signals, not chasing burn. Give yourself full credit for pressing play today.

weeks.themeSubtitle: Create room in the hips and spine where tension lives.

days.title: Tension Amnesty
days.intention: Today's long, quiet stretches invite the deep pelvic muscles to finally release their grip. We are building the habit now, with steady, repeatable, unhurried work. Trust the work. Your body is quietly getting stronger every session.

days.title: Gentle Circles
days.intention: Today's gentle circles restore the gliding, easy motion your pelvis is designed for. Your consistency this week wires in the connection we built earlier. Let this be your time: no rush, no judgment, just practice.

days.title: Down-Regulate Day
days.intention: Every long breath out today lets go of a little more of the clenching you have been carrying. This phase is about switching on the right muscles at the right moment. Move at your own pace and let your breath lead the way.

days.title: Deep Release Session

days.title: Slow Poses, Deep Relief
days.intention: Today's poses are chosen for comfort. Each one is a place your body can rest and open. This phase is about switching on the right muscles at the right moment. Notice how you feel before and after; that awareness is progress too.

days.title: Slow Sunday
days.intention: Let today feel like a long breath out: slow movement, deep breathing, no pressure. This phase is about switching on the right muscles at the right moment. Move at your own pace and let your breath lead the way.
